description:
Implement create_schema() with SQLGlot translation from DuckDB dialect
to Spark SQL dialect, handling Spark-specific limitations.

Spark SQL has different DDL constraints than DuckDB:
- CHECK constraints not supported
- PRIMARY KEY is informational only (not enforced)
- Different DECIMAL precision limits
- Supports PARTITIONED BY for performance tuning
- Supports USING clause for file format (PARQUET, DELTA)
